description: Companion module to read all signal enrichment outputs (supply_chain_enrichment, community_signal_enrichment, domain_trust_enrichment, tool_description_safety_enrichment, permission_scope_enrichment, temporal_stability_enrichment) and produce an aggregate discrimination_report dict listing how many distinct score values each enricher produces across the current mcp_server_registry corpus. Diagnostics-only: reads mcp_signal_enrichments via write_service, computes variance/stddev per signal_type, flags enrichers producing <5 distinct scores as BAD. Does not write to DB. Named output_file avoids build_ prefix.
